tasks.title: Keep dashboard Appearance actions readable at enlarged phone widths
tasks.body:
Goal:
Keep the dashboard Appearance action readable at enlarged phone widths.

Current behavior:
A current WebKit screenshot at 360 pixels and 200-percent text exposes a glyph-wide Customize theme action and a tall blank card. The phone rule assigns full width to both flex children; the Appearance flex row has no wrapping or phone direction change. The same source applies in Chromium and requires qualification.

Desired behavior:
Use scoped responsive wrapping or stacking so the label and action remain readable and bounded. Retain theme preferences, disclosure behavior and account status.

Touch:
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css`
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/Pages/DashboardPage.razor`
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/Pages/DashboardPageTests.cs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-dashboard-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-adapters.json`

Implementation constraints:
No text reduction, forced theme, new preference, provider request or interaction behavior change. Local synthetic build/test authorization applies. Physical devices and assistive technology remain unqualified.

Validation:
The original native screenshot supplies the failing layout regression. Include the real complete Appearance row in Razor fixtures and assert native button bounds, readable label width, visible focus and disclosure behavior. Retain existing dashboard action/freshness tests and the complete light/dark matrix including `obsidian-glow`.
